t.E1205.agn: In 2010 EFSA stated that it is not genotoxic; it did not set an ADI because reproductive data were lacking. Finding the calculated safety margins adequate, it concluded that use in food supplements at the proposed level did not raise a safety concern.
t.E1205.body: It is not absorbed because of its high molecular weight.
t.E1205.found.0: Food supplements (excluding chewable ones, up to 100,000 mg/kg)
t.E1205.prod: A polymer produced by the controlled polymerisation of methyl methacrylate, butyl methacrylate and dimethylaminoethyl methacrylate.
t.E1205.regx.0: No safety concern as a coating in food supplements at the proposed level.
t.E1205.summary: A synthetic polymer. It is used in the coating of supplement tablets.
t.E1205.what: A synthetic polymer used as a coating and glazing agent in food supplement tablets.
